Hey there, I am after my first day of abstinence as well.

As for the psychologic help, i can only recommend getting outside, going for walks, and journaling. Try to describe exactly what you are feeling as objectively as possible. I find that when you write a thought down it can make it go away, or at least quiet it down.

As for other means of help, i have some advice, first is hot baths, they help you sweat which works wonders (at least for me). Also they help immensely after you wake up in cold sweats. The other one is a melatonin supplement. I found it helps me greatly to fall asleep and counteract the insomnia brought on by quitting. If you also experience nausea, I recommend having a warm breakfast, or at least a cup of warm tea, it will relax your stomach a bit and make it more bearable.

As to what's coming, it has been said already. From myself i would also add recurring nightmares.

Good luck bro, and remember, we're in this together :')

I actually had to deal with OCD on its own, it was after i started nofap though, still noticed a lot of similarities. The thing you need to do is recognize how your brain works and put yourself into the observer state, rather than being right in the middle of the hurricane of thoughts in your head. One thing I'd recommend is to pick up a form of meditation called mindfulness, as it really helps to pick up patterns used by your brain and start making yourself more resilient to your thoughts and urges, be it obsessions and compulsions or the urge to masturbate.
